newsitem.title: USA: St. Paul estimates Hurricane Fran losses.
newsitem.headline: St. Paul estimates Hurricane Fran losses.

text.p: St. Paul Companies Inc said Tuesday that its third quarter pre-tax operating earnings will be cut by between $70 million and $75 million by the impact of Hurricane Fran and other storms.
Hurricane Fran, which primarily affected North Carolina and Virginia, will be responsible for about $40 million of the decrease in the insurance company's results.

"These third-quarter storm losses come on top of $115 million of pretax storm losses from the first half of the year. So 1996 is already The St. Paul's second-worst year on record for storm losses -- even though we have another quarter ahead of us," said Chairman Douglas Leatherdale in a statement.
St. Paul Companies provides property-liability insurance underwriting, reinsurance underwriting and insurance brokerage products and services worldwide.
